title: Origin story: Nezha
description: Nezha was born after three and a half years in his mother's womb, emerging able to walk and speak. He slew the Dragon King's son for demanding child sacrifices, then carved his own flesh to repay his parents and was reborn from lotus root by his master — returning as heaven's vanguard general.
